title: held --overlaps classifies each overlap and check warns of touches that name a CLI facade with no module behind it
goal: held --overlaps ID ends with one verdict line (CLAIMABLE, DOCS-ONLY or BLOCKED by FILE ITEM) and exits 0 for no overlap, 3 for a docs-only one and 1 for a code or test one, so a wrapper reads the class without parsing columns; check warns of an open item whose touches name _tools/backlog.py, _tools/kbgit.py, _tools/querylog.py or _tools/benchmarks.py and no bl_, kg_, ql_ or bench_ module, naming the module the map gives; today held exits 1 for every overlap and stale_touches finds only deleted paths, so facade touches made items overlap by name and missed the real file
notes: Theme: overlap rules and stale touches. Evidence: backlog.py:515-549 cmd_held exits 1 for any overlap and prints no verdict; bl_plan.py:62-84 stale_touches flags only paths the tree lacks, and takes a path no commit had for one to create (kb/_self/autopilot.md in BG-rgdrjsz6, BG-2lj5x3eh, BG-fmznri7r); a held-into-cut pipe hid the exit code twice (mac-third, mac-fourth); facade touches in 5 of 9 items (mac-fourth) and a 7-item replan (mac-seventh); the docs-overlap exception the manager granted verbally is written nowhere. Relates ST-igln3v6y (section-level claims of shared docs).
